about_the_game:
HomeStray is a heartfelt adventure-exploration game where you guide Omie, a lost puppy, across mysterious islands in search of his beloved Sophia.

Hop from island to island, solve puzzles, interact with charming creatures and NPCs. Discover new buddies along the way, each with special abilities that unlock new ways to navigate and interact with the world around you.

Experience a touching story about the many meanings of "home" as you shape Omie's journey through your choices, which affect his mental growth and ultimately determine one of multiple endings.

HomeStray combines charming exploration with meaningful decisions in a world filled with both comedy and hidden depths, where every distraction reshapes what "home" truly means.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or equivalent with at least 2GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit) or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or equivalent with at least 4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: Omie, once a beloved companion. Now, a wanderer of forgotten streets. It must face the vast and untamed world to find its way back to the love it lost, Sophia. Inspired by real-life experience, it’s all about the friendship between dogs and us. Wishlist HomeStray Now!
